content.comment_body: Hello, I have several systems operating with [product_name] version 6. Many of the expansion modules are now discontinued or hard to find. [product_name] version 8 expansion modules are suggested as substitutes. Can [product_name] version 8 expansion modules be used with a [product_name] version 6 base unit?
No. The modules from the [article_no] series work only with a matching [article_no] base unit or modules.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is looking for compatibility between newer expansion modules and an older base unit due to supply challenges. The reply confirms that the newer expansion modules are not compatible with the previous generation base unit, demonstrating a limitation in product compatibility and upgrade options.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes that the newer expansion modules would work with the old base unit or that there would be straightforward guidance for migrating to newer hardware.
